DISCOVERY 612, DEFENDANTS MORTEZA TAABODI, MARGARITA TAABODI'S MOTION TO COMPEL PLAINTIFF'S ATTENDANCE AT DEPOSITION IS GRANTED. NO OPPOSITION HAS BEEN FILED. PLAINTIFF IS ORDERED TO APPEAR FOR HER DEPOSITION ON A DATE NO EARLIER THAN JUNE 1, 2009 TO BE NOTICED BY DEFENDANT ON SHORTENED TIME AND BY PERSONAL SERVICE. PLAINTIFF IS FURTHER ORDERED TO APPEAR FOR A MEDICAL EXAMINATION ON A DATE NO LATER THAN JUNE 1, 2009, TO BE NOTICED ON SHORTENED TIME AND BY PERSONAL SERVICE BY DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF'S FAILURE TO APPEAR FOR HER DEPOSITION AND HER MEDICAL EXAMINATION WERE A MISUSE OF THE DISCOVERY PROCESS. SANCTIONS ARE IMPOSED AGAINST PLAINTIFF IN THE AMOUNT OF $712.62, TO BE PAID WITHIN 10 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. COMMISSIONER EVERETT A. HEWLETT, JR. MATTER NOT REPORTED.
